top_signals.title: Iran, US Trade Tanker Attacks, Strong US Payrolls Fuel Fed Hike Bets | The Asia Trade 9/7/2026
top_signals.summary: "Bloomberg: The Asia Trade" brings you everything you need to know to get ahead as the trading day begins in Asia. Bloomberg TV is live from Tokyo and Sydney with Avril Hong and Paul Allen, getting insight and analysis from newsmakers and industry leaders on the biggest stories shaping global markets.  (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: US, Britain to coordinate on scam center takedowns
top_signals.summary: The U.S. Department of Justice and the U.K.'s National Crime Agency and Crown Prosecutor signed a memorandum to cooperate on cases involving Southeast Asian scam operations.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
